convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load 'ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position sizing and trade execution. Custom indicator has no built-in MT5 equivalent.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

other_exits: Sell position closed when Color buffer[1]>5 (bullish signal reversal)
Buy position closed when Color buffer[1]<2 (bearish signal reversal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. Input MM=0.1 interpreted differently based on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: The ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle indicator uses color index values (0-10 range approximately) in buffer 1 to encode trend direction. Color[1]>5 means previous bar was bullish (trend up), Color[1]<2 means previous bar was bearish (trend down). The transition check (Color[0]<6 for buy, Color[0]>1 for sell) on the current signal bar acts as a confirmation that the color change is stable. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on bar index 1 (previous completed bar). Entry signals are gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose boolean inputs allowing selective enable/disable of each direction. UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime are passed to trade functions for trade timing/identification. LoadHistory() ensures historical data is available before signal evaluation. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorSchaffJCCXTrendCycle custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python or its signal logic reverse-engineered. It appears to be a Schaff Trend Cycle variant applied to JCCX (JMA-based CCI). The color buffer encoding (integer values representing trend state) must be replicated exactly. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions with margin-mode-dependent sizing - these need Python equivalents. The margin mode logic (LOT vs percentage modes) adds complexity. The GlobalVariableDel_ and CIsNewBar classes also come from the included library. SL/TP of 1000/2000 are in points (not pips), so 5-digit broker adjustment is not needed as the values already account for point-based pricing.
